verdict.rationale: Rollbar's Person Tracking explicitly quantifies how many distinct users are affected by each error item, supporting prioritization beyond raw event counts. However, evidence for session-level impact is thin — 'sessions' only appears as a pricing/quota metric, not as a per-item affected-sessions count, and Session Replay (beta) captures sessions around errors but isn't documented as an impact/prioritization metric. Missing for 10: explicit per-issue affected-sessions metric, and any documented 'blast radius' or impact-score ranking feature tying users+sessions together for triage.
